title: 第9章  扑进怀里第10章  床伴
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
谢烬沉看到小叔那严厉的语句，他身子抖了抖，好可怕！
他已经能想象到，小叔的神情了。
他原本是想让小叔知道，他是个痴情的男人，睡了这个雌性就想对她负责。
其实他是个花心的，他和季欢也就是玩玩。
因为季欢喜欢的人是永夜，他和永夜又是好兄弟，他怎么能抢他的女人呢？
所以，这段感情注定只能是地下情而已。
他赶紧回了一句。
【小叔，我知道了，不娶她了。】
发完他松了一口气，倒在床上继续睡觉。
季欢出来的时候，看他又睡着了，昨晚那么折腾，他今天应该能睡一天了。
不过，她和这家伙的交集也算是结束了，以后她就要离这家伙远远的了。
季欢换好衣服，出了卧室。
她换鞋的时候，系统出现。
【恭喜主人攻略谢烬沉成攻，奖励一颗起死还魂丹。】
季欢伸手接过，看着那颗绿色的小药丸，眼底闪过一丝惊喜。
有了这颗药之后，她就不怕自己死掉了，至少还有一次重生的机会。
她把药放进空间的保险柜里，好好的珍藏起来，这是可以保命的东西。
季欢收好药后，说了一句。
“狗系统，谢谢了！”
系统：【主人不用客气，这是你应得的，接下来，好好扮演恶女，祝你活到结局，然后回家。有任务我会及时通知你，再见！】

季欢松了一口气，没再给她布置攻略任务，太好了！
不过，程永夜身边也就裴西川和谢烬沉两个好兄弟，她都睡了，是不是任务就彻底完成了。
就在这时，门铃响了起来。
季欢走到门口，拉开门。
程永夜站在门口处，今天的他穿着白色的手工西服，还系了红格子领带。
这样的他，就像要去走红毯似的。
他冷着脸，往里面扫了一眼。
“昨晚你和谁在一起？”
他亲自给她做炭烤牛肉，那是她最喜欢的一道菜，每次他只要说做这个。
他们两个就算吵架，吵再凶，她都会原谅他，然后屁颠屁颠地去他家。
昨晚，她却拒绝他了。
程永夜一夜没睡好，觉得她可能是交男朋友了。
content_en:
Xie Jinchen trembled when he saw his uncle's harsh words. It was so scary!
He could already imagine his uncle's expression.
He originally wanted to let his brother-in-law know that he was an infatuated man, and he wanted to be responsible for this female after sleeping with her.
In fact, he is a playboy, and he and Ji Huan are just playing around.
Because the person Ji Huan likes is Yong Ye, and he and Yong Ye are good brothers, how can he steal his woman?
Therefore, this relationship is destined to be nothing more than an underground affair.
He quickly replied.
[Brother-in-law, I understand, I won’t marry her anymore. 】
After finishing speaking, he breathed a sigh of relief, fell on the bed and continued to sleep.
When Ji Huan came out, he saw that he had fallen asleep again. After so much trouble last night, he should be able to sleep for the whole day today.
However, her interaction with this guy is over, and she will stay away from this guy in the future.
Ji Huan changed his clothes and left the bedroom.
When she was changing her shoes, the system appeared.
[Congratulations to the master for mastering Xie Jin Shen's attack. You will be rewarded with a resurrection pill. 】
Ji Huan reached out and took it, looking at the small green pill, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
After having this medicine, she is no longer afraid of dying, and at least she has a chance to be reborn.
She put the medicine in the safe in the space and treasured it carefully. It was something that could save her life.
Ji Huan said something after collecting the medicine.
"Dog system, thank you!"
System: [Master, you're welcome, you deserve this. Next, play the role of a villain. I hope you survive to the end and go home. I will notify you in time if there are any tasks. Goodbye! 】
Ji Huan breathed a sigh of relief and did not assign any more strategy tasks to her. Great!
However, there were only two good brothers, Pei Xichuan and Xie Jinchen, beside Cheng Yongye. She had already fallen asleep, so the task was completely completed.
Just then, the doorbell rang.
Ji Huan walked to the door and opened it.
Cheng Yongye stood at the door. Today he was wearing a white handmade suit and a red plaid tie.
He looked like he was going to walk on the red carpet.
With a cold face, he glanced inside.
"Who were you with last night?"
He personally cooks charcoal-grilled beef for her, which is her favorite dish, and every time he just says to cook it.
Even if the two of them quarreled, no matter how violent the quarrel was, she would forgive him and go to his house.
Last night, she rejected him.
Cheng Yong didn't sleep well all night, thinking that she might have a boyfriend.
